note: Horizontal chrome, fonts and text casing of standard WPF controls under control-library themes, measured with WPF by prototype/ThemeChrome: the theme's dictionaries merged into Application.Resources as a project would, then the same probes as ChromeGen. chromeWidth includes the style's Padding and BorderThickness; paddingMode/borderMode say what an explicit value does (absent = not one-for-one, added on top). fontFamily/fontSize/fontWeight are listed only when the style sets them. casing is what the style does to string content. A profile applies only when the project references the same package major.minor. Numbers and style keys only; no theme XAML is copied.
